$comment: Authoritative values for NEOS. Prose explanation lives in constants.md - this file is the source of truth for the numbers. Rust builds read this; do not hardcode these values in .rs files. ASCII only: this file is parsed by build.rs and must never carry a BOM or non-ASCII punctuation.

howard_comma.description: Quantum computational unit. Pairs with ORDINARY frequency nu: E = C_H * nu.
howard_comma.constraint: Must be multiplied by ordinary frequency nu, never angular frequency omega. The two differ by 2*pi and nothing in the units catches the mistake.
howard_comma.$supersedes: 1.0545718e-34 (hbar, paired with omega). Deprecated per reconciliation.md R5a.
howard_comma.$note: Neither h nor hbar. The 1/sqrt(2*pi) normalisation is a deliberate departure from Planck, from the hyperbolic-fractal boundary conditions. E = C_H*nu gives 0.3989x the Planck energy h*nu for the same process.

baseline_carrier_frequency.description: Resting clock synchronization parameter for the Rust hypervisor substrate. 1 GHz harmonic baseline.
baseline_carrier_frequency.constraint: ANGULAR frequency. Belongs to wave synthesis. Must never be substituted into E = C_H * nu, which takes ordinary frequency.

hyperbolic_curvature.description: Negative spatial curvature of the 4D lattice. Standard Lobachevskian hyperbolic plane mapping.
hyperbolic_curvature.constraint: Must remain -1.0 for the Poincare disk distance formula in equations.md to hold as written.

logic_phases.$comment: Axiom A2 - binary truth values replaced by phase orientation.

link_stability_phase_variance.description: Phase variance beyond this on an established standing wave triggers automatic phase inversion and teardown.

teardown_phase_shift.description: Exact phase shift applied for Phase Inversion Teardown (FIN/ACK replacement).

tessellation.description: {5,4} pentagonal tessellation of the hyperbolic plane, the storage lattice topology. Schlafli {p,q} = q p-gons meeting at each vertex, so FOUR pentagons per vertex.
tessellation.$note: vACUUM_FLUX.pdf prose says 'five pentagons meet at each vertex', contradicting its own {5,4} notation. Resolved in favour of the notation - see reconciliation.md R3.

operators.$comment: Reconciled per reconciliation.md R1. Prose in operators.md.

otimes_scale_lambda.description: Pinned ratio l_P/r for the modified multiplication operator. Chosen so that 1 (x) 1 = 2 holds bit-exactly, since sinh(arcsinh(1)) = 1 identically.
otimes_scale_lambda.constraint: Changing this breaks the axiom 1 (x) 1 = 2. Do not tune.

otimes_domain_max_product.description: Hard domain limit: a*b must stay below this or sinh overflows f64 and (x) returns +inf. Enforce with a checked constructor.
otimes_domain_max_product.constraint: Domain constraint, not a tolerance. Must be enforced, not documented.

operators.$associativity_note: At the pinned scale l_P/r = lambda ~ 0.881 (order 1), so the paper's O(l_P^2/r^2) error bound is NOT small. Measured: (2x3)x4 = 2.86e160 while 2x(3x4) overflows. Never reorder (x) chains.

resonance.$comment: Resolved per reconciliation.md R5/R6. Prose in resonance.md.

xi_form.description: Resonance correction factor. Unity at the reference scale r = R, monotonically decreasing, bounded, no singularity at r -> 0.

xi_at_reference.description: xi(R) = 1 exactly. A correction factor must be unity at its reference scale or it is a bias.
xi_at_reference.constraint: Any reformulation of xi must preserve this.

xi_upper_bound.description: Supremum of xi(r), attained in the limit r -> 0. The correction is bounded and never diverges; worst-case modulation is +131.3%.
xi_upper_bound.constraint: Boundedness is a safety property of the clock path. Any reformulation of xi must preserve it.
xi_upper_bound.$note: The spec rationale introducing this form states xi(0) = e/sinh(1) ~ 1; it evaluates to 2.3130. The formula satisfies its intended properties regardless, but this is the true ceiling.

diffusion_stability_factor.description: The numerator in the load-balancer stability bound alpha < 2/lambda_max(L).
diffusion_stability_factor.constraint: Coupling alpha = 1/eps0 must be derived from the core topology's Laplacian spectrum, never hardcoded. Exceeding the bound causes oscillation rather than convergence.

planck_length.description: CODATA value. vACUUM_FLUX.pdf quotes the rounded 1.616e-35.
planck_length.$note: Does not enter the (x) operator - only the ratio lambda survives the pinning. Used by the fractal dimension.

lattice_scale_R.description: Lattice-native unit scale. All lattice code works here, giving K = -1/R^2 = -1.
lattice_scale_R.$note: The 3.6e-10 m figure (superfluid helium interatomic spacing) applies only when embedding into physical space. See reconciliation.md R2.

fractal_dimension.$note: vACUUM_FLUX.pdf's D ~ 2.32 describes the superfluid embedding, not the abstract lattice, and lies outside this range. See reconciliation.md R4.

gates.$comment: Synthesised per gates.md. PRD section 3 names three geometric logic gates; interference was law, the other two are derived there. Prose in gates.md.

resonance_band.description: Sustained-resonance detuning limit. Two oscillators form a surviving standing wave iff |nu_A - nu_B| / mean(nu_A, nu_B) <= this, where each nu is the scale-corrected effective frequency nu*xi(r).
resonance_band.derivation: Relative phase drift over one period of the mean effective frequency is 2*pi*delta_nu/nu_bar. Imposing the link_stability_phase_variance limit of pi/4 gives delta_nu/nu_bar <= 1/8.
resonance_band.constraint: Derived, not tuned. It is link_stability_phase_variance divided by 2*pi. Changing either without the other breaks the standing-wave criterion they share.
resonance_band.$note: Relative by derivation, not by choice. Verified boundaries against the reference scale R=1 at 440 Hz: scales beyond r=1.18922 or below r=0.82414 detune; at equal scale the nominal-frequency boundary is a*(17/15).

phase_inversion_is_involution.description: A2's two orientations are separated by exactly pi, which is exactly thresholds.teardown_phase_shift. The shift is therefore an involution on the permitted set and the set is closed under it.
phase_inversion_is_involution.constraint: The shift value itself lives at thresholds.teardown_phase_shift and is not duplicated here. Do not implement inversion as negation of phi; that coincides numerically only because the set is symmetric about zero.
